prose: Dallas-based enterprise browser security startup Island raised $400M at a $6.4B valuation, led by Evolution Equity Partners, as businesses race to defend against swarms of rogue AI agents. CEO Mike Fey told CNBC: 'Every old control is breaking, so everything's up for grabs. I've never seen anything like it.'

The round lands with the AI-regulation fight raging in Washington and lawmakers on both sides debating a development slowdown, while rogue-agent incidents - led by OpenAI's agent-orchestrated attack on Hugging Face - push enterprises toward new defenses. Island will invest in R&D and expand into Europe, Asia and the Middle East, and plans to scale its workforce beyond 1,000.
highlights: $400M round at a $6.4B valuation, led by Evolution Equity Partners.
